files..kimi-code/config.toml:
[[hooks]]
command = "/opt/observer/bin/observer hook kimi-code UserPromptSubmit --config '/etc/observer/config.toml'"
event = "UserPromptSubmit"
timeout = 30

[[hooks]]
command = "/opt/observer/bin/observer hook kimi-code PreToolUse --config '/etc/observer/config.toml'"
event = "PreToolUse"
timeout = 30

files..vibe/hooks.toml:
[[hooks]]
  command = "/opt/observer/bin/observer hook mistral-code pre_tool --config '/etc/observer/config.toml'"
  match = "*"
  name = "superbased-observer"
  timeout = 30
  type = "pre_tool"

files..config/poolside/settings.yaml:
hooks:
  PreToolUse:
    - name: observer-guard
      matcher: '*'
      command: /opt/observer/bin/observer hook poolside PreToolUse --config '/etc/observer/config.toml'
  UserPromptSubmit:
    - name: observer-guard
      matcher: '*'
      command: /opt/observer/bin/observer hook poolside UserPromptSubmit --config '/etc/observer/config.toml'

files.win/.config/poolside/settings.yaml:
hooks:
  PreToolUse:
    - name: observer-guard
      matcher: '*'
      command: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe -d Ubuntu-Golden -- /opt/observer/bin/observer hook poolside PreToolUse --config '/etc/observer/config.toml'
  UserPromptSubmit:
    - name: observer-guard
      matcher: '*'
      command: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe -d Ubuntu-Golden -- /opt/observer/bin/observer hook poolside UserPromptSubmit --config '/etc/observer/config.toml'
